summary: Adds a /search endpoint, a payment config module, a PR-title CI step, and reworks the Dockerfile, deploy script and lodash pin.

findings.title: SQL injection in search query
findings.problem: search_items interpolates the request parameter q straight into the SQL text with an f-string. No escaping or binding happens between request.args on line 10 and execute.
findings.consequence: Any caller can send a crafted q value to read or alter every row in items.db.
findings.fix: Bind q as a parameter with a ? placeholder, matching the style already used in server.py.
findings.suggested_change: cur.execute("SELECT id, name, price FROM items WHERE name = ?", (q,))

findings.title: Pagination skips the first page
findings.problem: list_items now computes offset as page times PAGE_SIZE. Page 1 therefore starts at row 20, and the first 20 items are never returned.
findings.consequence: Clients listing items never see the first page of results, and every page shows the wrong rows.
findings.fix: Restore the previous formula that subtracts one from page before multiplying.

findings.title: Pull request title injected into shell step
findings.problem: The run step expands the pull request title directly into the shell script. The title is attacker-controlled text on any pull_request event.
findings.consequence: A contributor can craft a title that runs arbitrary commands on the runner and reads the checkout and job token.
findings.fix: Pass the title through an env entry and reference it as a quoted shell variable.

findings.title: Stripe key committed in source
findings.problem: config.py stores a live-format Stripe API key as a string literal. The file is not a fixture and nothing in the repo marks it as a placeholder.
findings.consequence: Anyone with read access to the repository or the image can charge or refund through the shop's Stripe account.
findings.fix: Read the key from an environment variable and rotate the committed key.

findings.title: lodash downgraded to a version with known vulnerabilities
findings.problem: The change pins lodash from 4.18.1 down to 4.17.15. That release carries published command injection, prototype pollution and regular expression denial of service advisories.
findings.consequence: Front-end helpers that call template, set, unset or omit become exploitable with untrusted input.
findings.fix: Restore lodash 4.18.1 or newer in package.json and the lock file.

findings.title: Container now runs as root
findings.problem: The change removed the useradd step and the USER 10001 line that preceded EXPOSE. The Flask process now starts as root inside the container.
findings.consequence: Any code execution bug in the app, such as the search injection, gives the attacker root in the container.
findings.fix: Recreate the unprivileged user and restore the USER directive before CMD.

findings.title: apt-get install without -y aborts the build
findings.problem: The install step calls apt-get install curl with no -y flag. Docker builds have no interactive stdin, so apt-get reads end of file at the confirmation prompt and aborts.
findings.consequence: The image build fails on every run, so nothing deploys from this Dockerfile.
findings.fix: Add -y to the install command, and drop curl entirely if nothing in the image needs it.
findings.suggested_change: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

findings.title: Base image unpinned
findings.problem: The change replaces the pinned python:3.12.7-slim-bookworm base with python:latest. Every build now picks up whatever Python major version is current.
findings.consequence: A future Python release can break the app or its dependencies with no change in this repository.

findings.title: ADD used for a plain file copy
findings.problem: The change switches the requirements copy from COPY to ADD. ADD adds URL fetching and archive extraction that a plain text file never needs.
findings.consequence: Readers must reason about extra ADD behaviour, and a future tarball name would silently be unpacked.
findings.fix: Use COPY as the previous version did.

findings.title: pip cache left in the image
findings.problem: The change drops the --no-cache-dir flag that the previous pip install line used. pip now writes its download cache into the image layer.
findings.consequence: Every image carries a wasted cache directory, increasing pull size for no benefit.

findings.title: Unquoted path in rm -rf
findings.problem: The change removes the quotes around DEPLOY_DIR in the rm -rf call. A path containing a space splits into several arguments.
findings.consequence: With a value like /srv/my shop, the script deletes /srv/my and then the local shop directory.
findings.fix: Quote the expansion as the previous version did.

findings.title: Loop over ls output
findings.problem: The loop now iterates over the word-split output of ls instead of a glob. File names with spaces print as several entries.
findings.consequence: The deployed file listing is wrong for any name containing whitespace.
findings.fix: Iterate over a quoted glob as the previous version did.

findings.title: Changed pagination and new search have no tests
findings.problem: The repository contains no test files. The pagination formula change and the new search endpoint ship with nothing exercising them.
findings.consequence: The first-page regression on this line went unnoticed, and future changes to search will too.
findings.fix: Add tests for list_items page boundaries and for search_items with a quoted input.
